I searched the repo (excluding `node_modules` and `.next`) for the exact string `comment.created`. I dropped matches that were really `comment.createdAt` property accesses, and checked that nothing builds the name from pieces such as `` `comment.${...}` ``.

15 files contain the event name:

- **Emitter:** `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`
- **Subscribers:** the activity, search, webhook and notification services under `src/server/services/`
- **Types and schemas:** `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`
- **UI label:** `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`
- **Doc comment only:** `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`
- **Tests:** four test files

The string is also stored as a value: `activity-service.ts` records it as an activity type, and `webhook-service.ts` also passes it as the webhook event name. That means any saved activity rows or webhook subscriptions using the old name may need a data migration as well as the code change.

ANSWER: src/types/activity.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/schemas/activity.ts, src/schemas/webhook.ts, src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, tests/server/domain-events.test.ts, tests/services/notification-service.test.ts, tests/services/activity-service.test.ts, tests/services/comment-service.test.ts
